plain_reading: The ceiling is structural. After the label gates (eligibility, anchor, option checks) about 36 passage-and-form pairs at 12 settings have any passing question, and the no-passage check removes about half of what passes the key check (v1.0 47 percent, v1.1 50 percent guessable). A third writer pass tripled candidates and the v1.1 brief and program rules raised key soundness (62 to 70 percent) but neither moved the pair count or the guessability enough. 36 tasks cannot be reached by writing more questions on these 428 passages under these filters. Routes that remain are owner decisions outside plan 1.1: label more passages, lower the practice floor in a new plan version, or stop the line.
